mapper.select: select c.name name, count(d.id) value from dish_category c left join dish d on d.category_id = c.id group by c.id, c.name order by value desc

select case when health_goal is null or health_goal = '' then '未设置' else health_goal end name, count(*) value from user where role = 1 group by case when health_goal is null or health_goal = '' then '未设置' else health_goal end order by value desc
select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') name, count(*) value from orders group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by name desc limit 14
select concat(r.rating, '星') name, count(*) value from review r where r.status = 1 group by r.rating order by r.rating desc

select (select count(*) from user where role = 1) studentCount, (select count(*) from user where role = 2) merchantUserCount, (select count(*) from merchant) merchantCount, (select count(*) from stall) stallCount, (select count(*) from dish) dishCount, (select count(*) from dish where status = 1) onlineDishCount, (select count(*) from dish where audit_status = 0) waitAuditCount, (select count(*) from nutrition) nutritionCount, (select count(*) from orders) orderCount, (select count(*) from orders where status = 1) waitOrderCount, (select count(*) from review) reviewCount, (select count(*) from recommendation) recommendCount, (select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) from orders where status <> 4) orderAmount, (select count(*) from ai_call_log where success = 0) aiFailCount
